svg.title: LLaMA-Adapter: multi-scale feature extraction and fusion
svg.desc: Step-by-step diagram showing how CLIP extracts features from 4 transformer layers, concatenates them into a single vector, projects it into a prompt token, and injects it into LLaMA transformer layers.

g.text: single vector, shared by all layers

svg.text: repeated K times, element-wise added to adaptation prompts at each of L inserted layers
